covered_wave1: Smoke / fire / ambiguous segmentation + failure mining
over_represented_cap: uncertainty/calibration (26+ wave-1 ideas plus 18-idea confidence-inversion family per judge_C JC-MC-04; capped, top-up only in wave 3 if under-represented after Stage 2 dedup)

tasks.territory: Synthetic data + domain shift (generation-for-segmentation, sim-to-real, distribution shift science)
tasks.notes: Judge_C missing-territory hints usable as sub-domains: remote sensing/SAR (JC-MT-01), driving/3D LiDAR (JC-MT-02), industrial/agriculture/underwater (JC-MT-04).

tasks.territory: Super-resolution / restoration + diffusion models (restoration-segmentation coupling, generative priors, diffusion segmentation science)
tasks.notes: Judge_C missing-territory hints: microscopy/gigapixel WSI (JC-MT-03), video/streaming segmentation (JC-MT-05).

tasks.territory: Negative results + contrarian (things the community believes that may be false; published-method non-replication hypotheses; anti-scaling claims)
tasks.notes: Per judge_C JC-MC-01, avoid pure diagnostics/audit genre saturation; constructive contrarian claims preferred. Fairness/bias (JC-MT-07) and adversarial robustness (JC-MT-08) welcome as contrarian substrates.

wave3_planned_territories: cross-field (transfer of segmentation science to/from other fields)
uncertainty/calibration capped top-up only if under-represented after Stage 2 dedup (JC-MC-04)

shard_rules.id_seed_prefix_rule: use shard-unique id_seed prefixes (e.g. w14w2a-, w14w2b-, w14w2c-) per judge_C JC-QA-01
shard_rules.novelty_claims: do not state absence-of-prior-work as fact without literature search (judge_C JC-QA-02)
